ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there are two location maps on the left and right in the figure; place B in the right map is marked near the 40°N latitude line and near the 100°E longitude line, located in the inland area of northwest China. Then reason: the question stem states that places A and B are world-famous spaceflight centers. Combining B’s location at about 40°N and 100°E, it can be judged that B is near the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. Jiuquan is located in the Hexi Corridor; the regional climate is arid and precipitation is little, and nearby inland rivers such as the Heihe River mainly rely on the melting of alpine glaciers and seasonal snow in the Qilian Mountains for recharge. Therefore, the river recharge in region B is mainly ice and snow meltwater.
